Run GSEA on one metric of one cell line (or cell line comparison)

Source: R/plot-chemical_genomics.R
dot-cgs_fgsea.Rd

Drugs without a finite value of the metric are left out, since fgsea accepts only finite statistics. When no drug is left, an empty result is returned.

Usage

.cgs_fgsea(dt, metric, moa_list, name_col, moa_col, unit_name)

Arguments

dt

data.table with the metric column, drug names and MOAs.

metric

string, the metric column.

moa_list

named list of drug names per MOA.

name_col, moa_col

strings, the drug name and MOA columns.

unit_name

string, the cell line (or comparison) used in messages.

Value

data.table with the fgsea result and a median column; leadingEdge holds the leading-edge drugs as a comma-separated string.
